rows.jyutping: jung6 lai4 gaai2 sik1 ge3 N
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to describe something intended to explain, such as explanatory text.

example.english: This explanatory text is very clear.
example.traditional: 呢段用嚟解釋嘅文字寫得好清楚。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 jung6 lei4 gaai2 sik1 ge3 man4 zi6 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this formal written adjective in compounds such as explanatory text when a concise label is preferred.

example.english: The report includes explanatory text to help readers understand it.
example.traditional: 報告附有解釋性文字，方便讀者理解。
example.jyutping: bou3 gou3 fu6 jau5 gaai2 sik1 sing3 man4 zi6 fong1 bin6 duk6 ze2 lei5 gaai2

rows.note: Use this when a person is willing to explain rather than refusing or avoiding an explanation.

example.english: They’re explanatory, not evasive, when people ask questions.
example.traditional: 佢好肯解釋，問到乜都唔會避開。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 hang2 gaai2 sik1 man6 dou3 mat1 dou1 m4 wui5 bei6 hoi1
